'''Andrzej Wincenty Górski''' (15 August 1920 – 22 November 2017) was a Polish academic who was a professor of [[Inorganic Chemistry]] at the [[Warsaw University of Technology]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ch.pw.edu.pl/KATEDRA-CHEMII-NIEORGANICZNEJ-I-TECHNOLOGII-CIALA-STALEGO,,505.html|title=Katedra Chemii Nieorganicznej i Technologii Ciała Stałego - Katedra Chemii Nieorganicznej i Technologii Ciała Stałego - Politechnika Warszawska Wydział Chemiczny|accessdate=11 September 2013|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222140516/http://www.ch.pw.edu.pl/KATEDRA-CHEMII-NIEORGANICZNEJ-I-TECHNOLOGII-CIALA-STALEGO%2C%2C505.html|archivedate=22 February 2014}}</ref>

Górski was the author of a large number of research articles and two monographs on the systematics of chemical objects, as well as academic textbooks: "General Chemistry" and the two-volume textbook "Chemistry".<ref>{{cite web|author=Wojciech Bury|url=http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/|title=Prof. A. Górski|publisher=Ch.pw.edu.pl|date=1 May 2004|accessdate=17 September 2013|archive-date=18 November 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118035912/http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Andrzej W. Górski formulated the [[periodic table]] of atomic cores as co-ordination centres of chemical structural units and a uniform digital definition of [[acid]]s, [[Base (chemistry)|base]]s, [[oxidant]]s and [[reducer (chemistry)|reducer]]s which both form a basis for empirically verified, morphological classification of chemical structural units. The main area of scientific activity of A.W.Górski was the systematics of chemical objects.<ref name="Górski">{{cite journal |last=Górski |first=Andrzej |year=2001 |title=Morphological Classification of Chemical Structural Units |url=http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/PJChem-2001-75-159.pdf |journal=Polish J. Chem. |issue=75 |pages=159–207 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118040215/http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/PJChem-2001-75-159.pdf |archive-date=2016-11-18}}</ref>

The classification was verified in a vast range of empirical studies which had been carried out on the nature of mechanisms of [[thermal decomposition]] of [[chemical compounds]]. In the course of works on the classification of elements and chemical structural units a new version of the periodic chart has been created: Atomic Core Based Periodic System of Elements. This system is compatible with the established classification. It is also free from well known deficiencies which occur in the atom-based periodic system.<ref name="Górski2">{{cite journal |last=Górski |first=Andrzej |year=2005 |title=Atomic Core Based Periodic System of Elements |url=http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/PJChem-2005-79-1435.pdf |journal=Polish J. Chem. |issue=79 |pages=1435–43 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118040115/http://gorski.ch.pw.edu.pl/PJChem-2005-79-1435.pdf |archive-date=2016-11-18}}</ref><ref name="Górski"/>

==Biography==
Andrzej Wincenty Górski (the son of Marian Górski, an eminent agrochemist, who was twice rector of the [[Warsaw Agricultural University]]) was born on 15 August 1920, in [[Warsaw, Poland|Warsaw]]. In 1947, he graduated from the [[Department of Chemistry]] of the [[Warsaw University of Technology]] and received his doctorate degree there in 1952.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ch.pw.edu.pl/KATEDRA-CHEMII-NIEORGANICZNEJ-I-TECHNOLOGII-CIALA-STALEGO,,505.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222140516/http://www.ch.pw.edu.pl/KATEDRA-CHEMII-NIEORGANICZNEJ-I-TECHNOLOGII-CIALA-STALEGO,,505.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 February 2014|title=Katedra Chemii Nieorganicznej i Technologii Ciała Stałego - Katedra Chemii Nieorganicznej i Technologii Ciała Stałego - Politechnika Warszawska Wydział Chemiczny|date=22 February 2014|accessdate=29 November 2017}}</ref>

He became a professor of [[Inorganic Chemistry]] in 1965. Professor Andrzej W. Górski was a Dean of the [[Department of Chemistry]] at the [[Warsaw University of Technology]] from 1973–80, a member of the Board of the Polish Chemical Society<ref>{{cite web|url=http://en.ptchem.pl|title=PTChem|publisher=En.ptchem.pl|accessdate=17 September 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131016130341/http://en.ptchem.pl/|archive-date=16 October 2013|url-status=dead}}</ref> from 1972–79, the Vice-president of the Polish Chemical Society from 1974–76, the representative of the Polish Chemical Society at the Federation of Chemical European Societies – working party in education between 1973 and 1985, the Vice-Chairman of the National Research Project on Special Inorganic Materials from 1981–88 and the Chairman of the National Research Project on Special Inorganic Materials from 1988 to 1990. He died in November 2017 at the age of 97.<ref>[http://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,406977,Andrzej-Wincenty-Górski-nekrolog.html Andrzej Wincenty Górski death notice] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180923113418/http://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,406977,Andrzej-Wincenty-G%C3%B3rski-nekrolog.html |date=2018-09-23 }}, Nekrologi.wyborcza.pl; accessed 29 November 2017.{{in lang|pl}}</ref>
